column1: # Partition table for the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8 (16 MB flash).
# The bootloader occupies 0x0-0x8000 and this table itself 0x8000-0x9000
# the first partition starts at 0x9000. App partitions must begin on a 64 kB
# boundary; data partitions only need 4 kB alignment.
# nvs holds settings and checkpoints; web holds the gzipped UI assets. They are
# separate so that flashing a new UI image never erases settings. Both are far
# larger than they need to be
